summary: Closed intake for module `registration` after Solution Architect review passed. Delivered scope: registration first/last name capture and persistence; Google first-time registration consent gating; Gmail-backed welcome email trigger for new registrations; authenticated `/dashboard` shell with Home default, collapsible left menu, Feedback Request and Configure entries, user name, logout, and icon theme toggle; Feedback Request Excel upload with `purchase` batch creation, feedback rows, unique request links, and mockable email delivery/status tracking; public `/feedback/[identifier]` form with 30-day link validity, 1-10 rating, required message up to 200 characters, existing-record update, and read-only repeat-submission display. Iteration outcomes: iterations 1 through 5 passed delivery test and iteration review after recorded remediations; production verification succeeded after migration status was cleared; final Solution Architect review succeeded. Final review evidence passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd prisma migrate status` reported 5 migrations and database schema up to date; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; full unit source suite passed with 28/28 tests. Prior production verification records `npm.cmd run build` passed. Decisions recorded: production build is only required at final verification; feedback links remain valid for 30 days; repeat visits after submitted feedback show existing feedback; database migration was deployed before final release-readiness retry. Accepted limitations: browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, real Gmail delivery, and real customer contact were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
